# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

The instructions for this repository are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repo root, shared by every coding agent so that there is one copy. Read it
before you change anything, then [`docs/index.md`](../docs/index.md): the
approved design.

The rules in `AGENTS.md` under "Rules" are the owner's and are not optional:
changes to a running install and deletions need the owner's OK, merge only
when every check has passed, never print a secret.

Do not add project knowledge to this file. Put it in `AGENTS.md` or `docs/`,
in the same pull request as the change it describes.
